title: Financial Assistance Policy, Section 3 — Cases, Open Applications and Concurrent Awards
content:
**3.1** Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), a patient may have any number of assistance cases over time, but at most one open application (submitted or pending documents) and at most one approved award at a time (the maximum number of concurrent awards).

**3.2** A new application received while another application of the patient is open is added to that open case as supporting information, not opened as a second case.

**3.3** A renewal application filed within the award renewal window before the current award end date opens a new case whose award, if approved, starts the day after the current award ends; outside that window a new application while an award is approved is not accepted.

### Clause table

| Patient's position when an application arrives | Result |
|---|---|
| No open application, no approved award | a new case opens |
| An application of the patient is open (submitted or pending documents) | the new application is added to the open case as supporting information |
| An award is approved and the application is a renewal filed within the renewal window before the award end date | a new case opens; its award, if approved, starts the day after the current award ends |
| An award is approved and the application falls outside that window | not accepted |

There is no limit on the number of cases a patient may hold over time; the limits are on open applications and approved awards held at the same moment.
